Bigdata.com is still out of credits, so news is web only. key_risk: With the US on a half day, the next 24h is thin. The real risks are the weekend: OPEC+ sets 2027 policy on Sun 29 Nov amid Gulf attack headlines, which feeds oil, breakevens and THB. Then comes the 4 Dec NFP-to-9 Dec FOMC run, with a ~97% priced hike, which leaves the 10Y at 4.82 support exposed to any hawkish surprise.
